notes: Parts 01-05, 50 groups. Merged groups (one row each): Mercor = 6845f7d3186b + e8165f2fd8b3 + mercor hits 20b valuation + b012d65ebd4b + mercor doubles valuation to + 9aa2fc304e68; Anthropic IPO = anthropic seeks record 88 5b + anthropic ipo; OpenAI = openai reportedly + techfundingnews reports openais funding (the Nov 9 report of a round cut to $20B and the Nov 13-14 reports of $15B raised are treated as one round, amount = $15B); Fractile = uk backed + fractile hits 7 billion + nvidia rival fractile hits; Isomorphic Labs = isomorphic + demis hassabis + 8d8ac17268d7; Nominal = hardware testing startup + nominal reaches 3 billion. Round-ups expanded: crunchbase unicorn (October unicorn board; text truncated after four entries) -> TypeSafe AI, Manus AI, Nous Research, Upstage; softbank (BigGo feature) -> ABB Robotics acquisition + Gravis Robotics August Series A; to -> LSV Advisors stake sale + Avatar Growth Capital fund; funding report (AlleyWatch week ending 11/7, 24 deals) and funding report 2 (AlleyWatch week ending 11/14, 27 deals; its Mercor, Nominal, LangChain and Path Robotics items are folded into those rows; Edelbyte split into Seed + Series A). Both AlleyWatch parts had no text, so the deal lists come from fetching the publisher page: it gives amount, city, a one-line blurb and a backer list but no round type, lead or per-deal date, so those rows are Venture - Unspecified with the week-ending date (2026-11-07 / 2026-11-14) unless another source in these parts gave a date, and their evidence spans are the page values as returned by the fetch rather than checked verbatim quotes. Rows that restate a round already in data/rounds.json with a matching amount carry exclude_reason=duplicate and the stored announced_date (TypeSafe AI, Manus AI, Nous Research, Gravis Robotics, Applied Compute, Corridian, Firmly.ai, Harbinger, Kalepa, Larridin, Lazarus AI, Northwood Space, Numica, Ocient, Sentra, Traversal, Tutor Intelligence, Zipline International, Coframe). CONFLICT with data/rounds.json: Fractile is stored as $774M dated 2026-10-30, the official announcement here is $720M on 2026-11-11; OpenAI is stored as $11B dated 2026-11-06, reports here say $15B; CesiumAstro is stored as $730M, AlleyWatch lists $630M; Shield AI is stored as $1B Series H plus $500M debt, AlleyWatch lists $2.0B. Ottonomy: AlleyWatch lists $406.0M but the same entry gives total equity raised of $9.6M, so amount_usd is null and confidence 0.2. Upstage: only "October" is known, so the article date is used. Avatar Growth Capital: unresolved Google News link, title only. India AI (Tracxn) names February-August rounds (Neysa, Sarvam, Kandou, Yotta, Emergent, Freehand) with month-only dates, mostly older than the 120-day window, so it is kept as one not-funding row. Sidebar headlines inside article texts (Blue J, Mosaic, Kindo, Genesis AI, redalpine and others) were not turned into rows. Lookups used: 16 of 25 (AlleyWatch 11/9 and 11/16 pages; techfundingnews Agile Robots; TechCrunch Isomorphic Labs; mlq.ai Grab/SoftBank/PETROS; tradersunion LangChain, which returned 403; searches for Path Robotics, Science Corporation, LangChain, Nominal, Rowan Digital Infrastructure, Imprint, Databento, Edelbyte and Garage; robotics247 Path Robotics article). Validator caveat: for Agile Robots, Isomorphic Labs and the AlleyWatch rows the extra facts came from the candidate's own URL (parts text was thin, skipped or empty), so validate-extracted will not find those investor names or amounts in the stored text and will drop the names and cap confidence at 0.5 unless the candidate text is refreshed.
